table_attributes.Sql Query:
SELECT 
	MAX(PAY_PERIOD.PP_NUM) PP_NUM , 
	MAX(PAY_PERIOD.PP_END_YEAR) PP_END_YEAR 
FROM
 PAY_PERIOD

table_attributes.Lookup Sql Override:
SELECT 
	COUNT(*) as COUNT_CURRENT
FROM 
	PAY_PERIOD
WHERE
	CURR_PP_FLAG = 'Y'

fields.name: o_CURRENT_FLAG_SET
fields.expression:
DECODE(TRUE,
				v_CURRENT_FLAG_SET = TRUE, 
						'!!!! Current flag has been properly set',


				v_CURRENT_FLAG_SET = FALSE AND 
				(ISNULL (lkp_COUNT_CURRENT) OR lkp_COUNT_CURRENT = 0), 
					       ABORT('!!!! There is no pay period set.'),


				v_CURRENT_FLAG_SET = FALSE AND 
						lkp_COUNT_CURRENT > 1, 
       ABORT('!!!! There are more than one pay periods set to current.')
)

table_attributes.Sql Query:
SELECT 
	MAX(PAY_PERIOD.PP_NUM) PP_NUM , 
	MAX(PAY_PERIOD.PP_END_YEAR) PP_END_YEAR 
FROM
 PAY_PERIOD

fields.name: v_SUBJECT
fields.expression:
v_ENVIRONMENT ||
'Pay Calendar Process Completed Successfully for: ' || 
TO_CHAR(PP_END_YEAR) || '-' || v_PP_NUM

fields.name: v_MESSAGE
fields.expression:
'Current Pay Period = ' || v_PP_NUM || 

CHR(10)  || 

'Begin Date         = ' || TO_CHAR(PP_START_DTE, 'MM/DD/YYYY') || 

CHR(10)  || 

'End Date           = ' || TO_CHAR(PP_END_DTE, 'MM/DD/YYYY')

tasks.DESCRIPTION: This session retrieves the record from the Pay Period table currently set to current and resets that record to the default.
tasks.NAME: s_Pay_Calendar_Reset_Pay_Calendar

tasks.DESCRIPTION: This task uses the workflow variables WF_SUBJECT and WF_MESSAGE to notify operators of the Current Pay Period.
tasks.NAME: Email_Pay_Calendar

tasks.DESCRIPTION: This session queries the Pay Calendar table for the record marked current and uses that record to build the subject and message for an email message. The subject and message built in this session  are assigned to workflow variables WF_MESSAGE and WF_SUBJECT respectively. They will be used by the following Email Task.
tasks.NAME: s_Pay_Calendar_Build_Message

tasks.DESCRIPTION: This session uses the contents of a parameter file to determine whether a row will be set to current on the Pay Period table. If the parameters within the parameter file are set, the values within the parameter file will be used to determine the current pay period. If the parameters within the parameter file are empty, the system date will be used to determine the current pay period.
tasks.NAME: s_Pay_Calendar_Set_Pay_Calendar
